sloka: हिमवंतम् च मेरुम् च समुद्रम् च तथा उत्तरम् ।यदा न विन्दे शरणम् वालिना समभिद्रुतः ॥४-४६-२०॥
transliteration: himavaṁtam ca merum ca samudram ca tathā uttaram ।yadā na vinde śaraṇam vālinā samabhidrutaḥ ॥4-46-20॥

translations.english: 'I saw Himavan and mount Meru on the north and the northern sea. Still pursued by Vali, I could not know where to go when wise Hanuman spoke to me these words:
